name: 32618 · Archer, FL
findings: ZIP 32618 (Archer) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32618 (Archer) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
